quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on Caleb Wilson's skill set and draft potential
quotes.excerpt: I might pick him number one. For sure top three because he can play five, four, three.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: Caleb Wilson, when I first seen the skill set, I was like, I might pick him number one. For sure top three because he can play five, four, three. The way he moves, his attributes, he got the one-on-one game, the fades. I'm watching like, yo, he can cover a lot of positions.

text_blocks.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
text_blocks.text: So when you're talking about drafting, you can pick him at the five, get a five and play him at the four, get a four, play him at the three. So he can play three, three different positions.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on why he hates the NBA draft process
quotes.excerpt: I hate the draft process because you can't, it's college basketball. How many other top-tier point guards?

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: His only problem was with his skill set, if you go into the drive and you can't go against somebody else and you got to work out by yourself, that's the downfall. Five on five, one on one, that's his skill set. So him playing in summer league, he's going to thrive. Him going in a workout and everybody going to dodge him, like if you're a top five pick and you know he's a one-on-one guy, you ain't working out with him. He dangerous. Yeah, so you're going to dodge him and every time he can't work out with somebody, he going to slip. Because now it's just him and his, his ability and everybody's like, I don't know.

text_blocks.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
text_blocks.text: Is that more on the fault of how players are evaluated though? Because it feels like guys like that slip through the cracks all the time.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: I hate the draft process because you can't, it's college basketball. How many other top-tier point guards did you play against at your position? Some of you played none. So you're gumming in with your college status into this workout. I'm a top-tier guard. I want to show you that I'm better than you. You're going to dodge me the whole time. Shit, I'm a dodge the person that's trying to get me. So we've never been tested actually in real life yet.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his contract negotiations and the Gil's Arena show
quotes.excerpt: It was basically my contract was coming up. So it was basically we're going to negotiate you.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: It was basically my contract was coming up. So it was basically we're going to negotiate you, we're going to negotiate while you, while you on the floor. Right. So it was basically like a, it seemed like a just a takeover. So we started off number one show, number one basketball show, right, live show on the internet. We go from four days, thinking we about to get five days, go to two days. Right. So it was basically this big standoff. So it's like, all right, this how y'all want to play? And it was like, yeah, you know, this is part of the negotiation. And I was like, you don't want to negotiate with a dude like me. I'm an athlete. This what I do. I like this type of back and forth. So I thought we was family. If you're going to let the dude come in, I know how this is going to end. He's not smart enough in this tactical realm to go against me.

text_blocks.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
text_blocks.text: So no, nobody from Gil's Arena is coming back? It's just you?

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: They, I don't know, man. Josiah. Shout out Josiah. You know what I mean? That's my guy.

quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on why he is the reason Kevin Durant is a Hall of Famer
quotes.excerpt: I'm the reason he's a Hall of Famer. He don't even know it.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: I was a free agent. I was supposed to go to Denver. But they signed Andre Miller. See, they signed Andre Miller. He got to be him. If they'd have signed me, you better get it off the glass, bro. You better get it off the glass. This is 50 something million right here.

text_blocks.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
text_blocks.text: I mean, you got to explain that. I don't know where he going.

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: I'm the reason he's a Hall of Famer. He don't even know it. That's why his face is like, wait, what? I know he going. He don't know. I listen, I was a free agent. I was supposed to go to Denver. This is 50 something million right here.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the unique, high-scoring nature of his era
quotes.excerpt: Everybody had different levels, different ways of getting into that chamber, which made that era of basketball
quotes.quote: You knew Mac was going to play a game. He might come out and try to get five assists early, work the game, and then you look up and he has 35. He just scores in bunches. Vince, now Vince run, Vince get on the run, he is shooting fadeaway threes, he is dunking, he is fast breaks, he is steals. He was doing everything, whereas we were just trying to kill you. Vince was in passing lanes, he is steals, he is offensive rebounding, he is getting it off the rebound, he is pushing the ball. He might pull up from half if he is hot. He might shoot a come-over pick and shoot a fadeaway three from the hash if he is hot. So everybody had different levels, different ways of getting into that chamber, which made that era of basketball some of the most unique basketball that was played as far as individual talent goes.

quotes.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
quotes.summary_phrase: Kazeem Famuyide on the importance of star power in the current NBA
quotes.excerpt: I feel like in your era, if you had a guy like yourself, a guy like Gil, a guy like AI
quotes.quote: It almost feels like now, depth is what everybody wants. But I feel like in your era, if you had a guy like yourself, a guy like Gil, a guy like AI, T-Mac, Vince, every night, you never know who could go off. But that is who is winning now. The guys who got that guy. That is who is winning the championships now. The guys who got that guy.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on Jalen Brunson's unique status among small guards
quotes.excerpt: Only Steph and Isaiah Thomas is the only guards, 6'3 and under, to be the guy on the team
quotes.quote: What Brunson did, people don't really understand. There has only been, outside of what he just did, only Steph and Isaiah Thomas is the only guards, 6'3 and under, to be the guy on the team to win a chip. It has only been them two, right? So for him to do it, that already is amazing. But how he did it in the city he did it in is very different. The pressure is on more. I mean, you are some crazy fans. It made me want to be a New York fan. And it made the league pop. We doing it wrong, everywhere else we are doing it wrong. We are not celebrating our team the way we need to celebrate our team.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on the Knicks' mental toughness during their playoff run
quotes.excerpt: No matter how much they went down, they were never out of it mentally
quotes.quote: No matter how much they went down, they were never out of it mentally. You didn't see no panic in those boys. One word, but grit. It was like grit. The only time they looked like they wasn't playing New York basketball, I forgot what game it was. Was it game three where they were trying to bully? They were trying to bully in the Trump game, and they went down 30. I am like, no, they end up winning. No, the game they end up coming back and won. They were sitting there trying to play the bully basketball game. It was game four. They are bullying them. I am like, yo, that is not y'all. That is not y'all. It was when Wemby was doing that shit. They were just playing out of character. Then in the second half, they kind of got back to just playing how they play and end up coming back and winning the game.

quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on the elite players he tested his skills against in practice

quotes.quote: Chris Paul, Dwyane Wade, Melo, LeBron James, Dwight Howard. I would never, ever, ever, as an NBA player, ever play against a five like that to test my talent. Remember, I am playing against the second unit in practice. So this is the best five I am ever play against. So I took this shit seriously. I knew I wasn't getting on the court. One, I got Adidas on. quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas

quotes.quote: You can see they're moving at a different speed. Even CP, right? Even though I'm a two-time All-Star, you can see they're moving at a different speed. So if you sit there and look at everybody, it's like, oh, I'm the odd man out now, because my, I'm, I'm just a score. So I'm naturally, on this setting, I'm a six-man, seven-man. I'm not, I'm not a pure point, and you know, like, if you do put me at the shooting guard, like Dwyane Wade is a better shooting guard than me with this roster. Better point guard with this roster, that is CP. Even coming off the bench, I'm more of a shooting guard than I am a passing to these guys.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on the mental challenges of being a young NBA player
quotes.excerpt: Most people don't realize that the player himself is still in his career when his child is
quotes.quote: Most people don't realize that the player himself is still in his career when his child is going through those developmental stages, right? So it's hard for the the the father to really put in, because he still put into the career to keep the, you know, the family going. So me, I was retired before Elijah started basketball. So when he decided to touch the ball, I was there hands-on, right? Six in the morning, let's go, because I'm still working out. So I got to really train him, right? To really see, like, okay, all right, okay, now, oh shit, now he hit a growth spurt. Oh, now you talking different. Now you 6'7, 6'8, long arms, you really have a shot.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on the importance of mental readiness for young players
quotes.excerpt: If I don't think you're ready mentally, you're not going. And I didn't think he was ready yet
quotes.quote: If I don't think you're ready mentally, you're not going. And I didn't think he was ready yet. And I'm like, just go back for one more year, get your shit, get your life. It's more your life. Because you don't want to, with your life right now, you don't want to go into the NBA with the lifestyle. You don't, you don't have the baggage of having friends and all of that. But just understanding what, what it is to be a professional. Because if you can't be a professional, understanding like, NBA is 90% of your life when you first get in there. You got lions in there. And them, them lions, bro, there's no coming in and you got a name. Nah, they, they're going to tear through that name. You got to stand on your own first.
